title: Surjective homology map of a total resolution
statement: Let $R$ be a ring, $n$ an integer, $M^\bullet$ a cochain complex of $R$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and $K^{p,q}$ an integer-indexed bicomplex of $R$-modules whose horizontal and vertical differentials increase their respective indices and commute. Assume that every column $K^{p,\bullet}$ with $p>0$ is zero. Form the direct-sum total complex with $\operatorname{Tot}^k=\bigoplus_{p+q=k}K^{p,q}$ and differential $d_h+(-1)^p d_v$ on column $p$. Let $a:K^{0,\bullet}\to M^\bullet$ and $\varepsilon:\operatorname{Tot}\to M^\bullet$ be maps of complexes. Assume that the restriction of $\varepsilon$ to $K^{0,q}$ is $a^q$ for every integer $q$, and that $a$ induces a surjection $\ker(d_v^{0,q})\to\ker(d_M^q)$ for every integer $q$. Then $H^n(\varepsilon)$ is surjective, where cohomology means cycles modulo boundaries.

proof.text:
Represent a degree n homology class of M by a cycle m. Surjectivity
of the augmentation on cycles gives a cycle x in (K.X 0)^n mapping to m.
Include x into the column-zero summand of the total complex. Its vertical
differential is zero since x is a cycle; its horizontal differential
lands in the zero column K.X 1, and hence is also zero. Thus it is a total
cycle. The augmentation identity on column zero says its image is m, so
its homology class is a preimage of the given class. This argument works
for every integer n and requires neither boundedness nor the other exact rows.

lean.statement:
theorem total_resolution_homology_surjective
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat R) ℤ)
    (K : HomologicalComplex₂ (ModuleCat R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
    [K.HasTotal (ComplexShape.up ℤ)]
    (ε : K.total (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⟶ M)
    (a : K.X 0 ⟶ M)
    [∀ i, (K.total (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).HasHomology i]
    [∀ i, M.HasHomology i]
    [∀ p q, (K.X p).HasHomology q]
    (n : ℤ)
    (h_positive : ∀ p : ℤ, 0 < p → IsZero (K.X p))
    (h_augmentation_zero : ∀ q : ℤ,
      K.ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0 q q (by simp) ≫ ε.f q = a.f q)
    (h_cycles_surjective : ∀ q : ℤ, Function.Surjective
      (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap a q).hom) :
    Function.Surjective (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap ε n).hom
